root_cause: The build itself (CMake configure/build/install, packaging) completed successfully; the failure occurred purely in the 'Upload OpenVINO package' step while streaming the openvino_package.tar.gz artifact to GitHub Actions' Azure Blob Storage backend (productionresultssa31.blob.core.windows.net). A DNS lookup for that storage host transiently failed (getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN) partway through the upload (after 16MB had already been sent), causing the upload-artifact action to error out even though bytes continued to be reported as uploaded afterward. This is unrelated to the PR's actual change (a one-line logic fix in .github/scripts/npu_cip_detect_bump.py, unrelated to the build/upload pipeline) and is consistent with a brief runner-side or GitHub-infrastructure DNS/network blip rather than a code or configuration defect.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reliably reproducible locally; depends on transient DNS/network conditions between the GitHub Actions runner and Azure Blob Storage during artifact upload.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed merge-queue Build job; this is a transient network failure unrelated to the PR's code changes.
No code changes needed in .github/scripts/npu_cip_detect_bump.py or the build workflow.

If this recurs frequently for large artifact uploads, consider enabling retry-with-backoff wrapping around the ababushk/upload-artifact step, or monitor for a broader GitHub Actions/Azure infrastructure incident.
prevention_strategies: Track recurrence of this 'getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN ... blob.core.windows.net' signature (already covered by the workflow rerunner's approved 'getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN' search string, ticket 182238) across merge-queue runs; if it crosses the 3-in-12h threshold, escalate for GitHub/Azure infrastructure investigation rather than treating it as a code regression.
historical_context: Related but distinct DNS-resolution failures against the same productionresultssa*.blob.core.windows.net hosts have been recorded before: pattern 688d70acdbdfc8ce ('urlopen error errno 11001 getaddrinfo failed', NPU model download, PR #38400) and pattern dfd265b1c0ea3af5 (EasyOCR model download, PR #38219), and investigation 2026-10-30-04-34-49-065-40999556324 recorded an npm actions-cache restore failure against productionresultssa0.blob.core.windows.net on the same day. This is the first recorded occurrence specifically during an upload-artifact (ababushk/upload-artifact) blob upload of a build package rather than a cache restore or external model download, but it is part of the same broader family of intermittent Azure Blob Storage DNS reachability issues.
